description.value:
The Soviets value simple solutions. This is why the T40 Uragan doesn't pretend to be something that it's not. The Uragan is a rocket launcher that launches rockets. It won't read your body temperature, measure atmospheric pressure or remind you of your mom's birthday. You press a button, something explodes. That's it. Anything else a competing launcher offers is just another frivolous product of runaway capitalism.

Cost: 1,200eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Rocket Launcher • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Rocket Launcher

Damage: 8d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Explosive

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Long Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon’s magazine can be loaded with up to 5 different types of Ammunition, with the user selecting which to use when firing this weapon. This weapon requires three Actions to Reload.

Range: Rocket Launcher
Pre-installed: Long Scope (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Explosive

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
